vocabularies.definition: A very young child, especially one that cannot walk or talk yet.
vocabularies.example:
The baby is sleeping in the crib.
She gave birth to a healthy baby girl.
He looks just like his father when he was a baby.
quizzes: The newborn __________ cried when she was hungry.
Can you help me feed the __________ her milk?
She bought some cute clothes for the new __________.

vocabularies.definition: A young child who is just learning to walk.
vocabularies.example:
The toddler took his first steps yesterday.
She teaches at a playgroup for toddlers.
It is hard to keep a toddler sitting still for long.
quizzes: A __________ needs constant supervision because they walk around and touch everything.
My little brother is a __________ and he loves to explore the house.
The toy is safe for a __________ over the age of two.

vocabularies.definition: A young human being below the age of puberty or below the legal age of majority.
vocabularies.example:
Every child has the right to education.
She is an only child.
When I was a child, I wanted to be an astronaut.
quizzes: A young __________ needs a lot of sleep and healthy food.
She is the eldest __________ in her family.
The school has many activities to help a __________ learn and play.

vocabularies.definition: A male child or young man.
vocabularies.example:
The little boy is playing with his toy cars.
He is a very polite boy.
Who is that boy sitting next to your sister?
quizzes: The young __________ ran to catch the school bus.
He is a smart __________ who loves science experiments.
The tall __________ is the captain of the soccer team.

vocabularies.definition: A child or young person (informal).
vocabularies.example:
The kids are playing in the backyard.
When I was a kid, we lived in the countryside.
She is a very nice kid.
quizzes: The school playground was full of __________s running around.
He is just a __________ and still has a lot to learn.
We used to ride our bikes all day when we were __________s.

vocabularies.definition: A female child or young woman.
vocabularies.example:
The little girl is wearing a beautiful pink dress.
She is a very talented girl.
Who is that girl with long blond hair?
quizzes: The young __________ drew a colorful picture of a rainbow.
She is a clever __________ who always gets good grades.
The __________ in the blue jacket is my cousin.

vocabularies.meaning: thanh thiếu niên (đang tuổi dậy thì)
vocabularies.definition: A young person who is developing from a child into an adult.
vocabularies.example:
Adolescents often experience many physical and emotional changes.
It can be difficult to communicate with an adolescent.
The book is written for adolescents.
quizzes: Many __________s face peer pressure at school.
An __________ is no longer a child but not yet a fully grown adult.
The program helps __________s build confidence and life skills.

vocabularies.meaning: người ở tuổi thiếu niên (13-19 tuổi)
vocabularies.definition: A person aged between 13 and 19 years.
vocabularies.example:
Most teenagers love spending time with their friends.
She behaves like a typical teenager.
He has two teenage sons.
quizzes: A __________ often spends a lot of time on social media.
When you turn thirteen, you officially become a __________.
The clothing store sells trendy outfits for __________s.

vocabularies.definition: A person who is fully grown or developed.
vocabularies.example:
Children must be accompanied by an adult.
He behaves like a mature adult.
It is hard work being an adult.
quizzes: Tickets are cheaper for children than for __________s.
When you grow up, you will face the responsibilities of an __________.
The movie is suitable for both kids and __________s.

vocabularies.definition: An adult male human being.
vocabularies.example:
He is a man of his word.
A tall man was standing near the door.
He grew up to be a very kind man.
quizzes: The __________ wearing the black suit is our new principal.
She asked the __________ at the reception desk for directions.
A wise old __________ gave me some excellent advice.

vocabularies.definition: An adult female human being.
vocabularies.example:
She is a very strong and independent woman.
A young woman waved at us.
Who is that woman over there?
quizzes: The __________ who lives next door is a famous doctor.
She grew up to be a successful business__________.
A kind __________ helped the lost boy find his mother.

vocabularies.definition: An elderly human being.
vocabularies.example:
We should always show respect to an old person.
An old person was crossing the street slowly.
She volunteers to help old people in the community.
quizzes: You should offer your seat on the bus to an __________.
The __________ smiled warmly and thanked us for our help.
My grandfather is a wise __________ who tells great stories.

vocabularies.definition: Of a color intermediate between black and white, as of ashes or lead.
vocabularies.example:
He has beautiful gray eyes.
His hair is starting to turn gray.
The sky looks very gray and cloudy.
quizzes: She looked at me with her calm __________ eyes.
My grandfather has __________ hair and a long beard.
He wore a smart __________ suit to the interview.

vocabularies.definition: Of a color produced by mixing red, yellow, and black, as of dark wood or rich soil.
vocabularies.example:
She has big brown eyes.
He wears a brown leather jacket.
The dog has soft brown fur.
quizzes: Most people in Asia have dark __________ eyes.
He painted the wooden fence a dark shade of __________.
She carried a light __________ handbag that matched her shoes.

vocabularies.definition: Of the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum; colored like grass or emeralds.
vocabularies.example:
She has striking green eyes.
The grass is bright green in spring.
He wore a green sweater.
quizzes: It is rare to see someone with natural __________ eyes.
The leaves on the trees are starting to turn __________ again.
The cat's glowing __________ eyes could be seen in the dark.

vocabularies.definition: Of a color intermediate between green and violet, as of the sky or sea on a sunny day.
vocabularies.example:
The baby has bright blue eyes.
She has a blue ribbon in her hair.
The sky is blue and clear today.
quizzes: He was born with deep __________ eyes like his mother.
She wore a beautiful __________ dress to the party.
The ocean looked calm and __________ under the morning sun.

vocabularies.meaning: màu hạt dẻ (mắt nâu vàng lục)
vocabularies.definition: A greenish-brown or yellowish-brown color, especially used to describe eye color.
vocabularies.example:
She has lovely hazel eyes that change color in the sun.
His eyes are hazel, a mix of brown and green.
She wore makeup that complemented her hazel eyes.
quizzes: Her __________ eyes seemed to look gold in the bright sunlight.
He has a combination of green and brown in his __________ eyes.
The girl with the __________ eyes smiled at the camera.

vocabularies.definition: Having little or no hair on the head.
vocabularies.example:
He went bald in his late twenties.
My uncle is completely bald.
He has a bald head and wears glasses.
quizzes: The actor is famous for his shiny __________ head.
He decided to shave his head completely when he started going __________.
A __________ man was sitting at the front row.

vocabularies.definition: No longer present; departed, used up, or disappeared.
vocabularies.example:
Look, all his hair is gone!
Where is my phone? It is gone!
When we arrived, the cake was already gone!
quizzes: I left my keys on the table, but now they are __________!
He looked in the mirror and realized his hair was completely __________!
All the cookies in the jar are __________!

vocabularies.definition: Pale; light in color (used for skin or hair).
vocabularies.example:
She has fair skin that burns easily in the sun.
He has short, fair hair.
She looks beautiful with her fair complexion.
quizzes: People with __________ skin need to wear sunscreen in summer.
She has long, __________ hair that looks almost blonde.
Her face was __________ and smooth.

vocabularies.definition: Measuring a small distance from end to end, or small in height.
vocabularies.example:
She cut her hair short.
He is quite short for his age.
We took a short break after the exam.
quizzes: He is the __________est student in our class.
She prefers to keep her hair __________ because it is easy to wash.
The teacher gave us a __________ story to read for homework.

vocabularies.definition: Of a yellow or pale golden color (used to describe hair).
vocabularies.example:
She has long blond hair.
The boy with blond hair is my cousin.
His hair is naturally blond.
quizzes: The little girl has beautiful curly __________ hair.
Is your brother's hair dark or __________?
She dyed her hair __________ for the summer.

vocabularies.definition: Without a curve or bend; not curly or wavy.
vocabularies.example:
She has long, straight black hair.
I wish my hair was straight instead of curly.
Use a hair straightener to make your hair straight.
quizzes: Her hair is naturally __________ and smooth.
She got tired of her curly hair and decided to get it __________ened.
He has short, __________ hair that is easy to style.

vocabularies.definition: Made of curves or ringlets (used to describe hair).
vocabularies.example:
She has beautiful curly red hair.
His hair becomes very curly when it is wet.
She uses special shampoo for her curly locks.
quizzes: The baby has cute __________ hair that looks like springs.
My sister has straight hair, but I have __________ hair.
He brushed his __________ hair to make it look neat.

vocabularies.definition: A pale shade of the color brown.
vocabularies.example:
She has light brown hair that shines in the sun.
He has light brown eyes.
They painted the room a light brown color.
quizzes: Her hair is not dark, it is a lovely __________ color.
He wore a pair of __________ leather shoes.
The puppy has soft __________ fur with white paws.

vocabularies.definition: Having sharp points; (of hair) styled to stand up in points.
vocabularies.example:
He put gel in his hair to make it spiky.
The boy has cool spiky hair.
I don't like my hair when it looks too spiky.
quizzes: He used strong hair gel to create a __________ hairstyle.
The teenager loves wearing his hair __________ and messy.
She laughed at his __________ hair after he woke up.

vocabularies.definition: Of a color like blood or a ruby; also used for orange-brown hair.
vocabularies.example:
She has natural red hair and freckles.
He drove a shiny red sports car.
Her face turned red when she was embarrassed.
quizzes: People with __________ hair are sometimes called 'gingers'.
She painted her nails a bright __________ color.
The teacher used a __________ pen to correct our mistakes.

vocabularies.definition: A reddish-brown color, especially used to describe hair.
vocabularies.example:
She has long auburn hair.
His hair has a beautiful auburn tint in the sunlight.
Auburn is a very warm and rich color.
quizzes: Her __________ hair looked stunning against her green dress.
He has dark eyes and wavy __________ hair.
She decided to dye her hair a deep __________ shade.

vocabularies.definition: Measuring a great distance from end to end, or having a great length.
vocabularies.example:
She has very long hair that reaches her waist.
It was a long and tiring journey.
We had a long discussion about the project.
quizzes: How __________ is your hair now?
She braided her __________ hair to keep it out of her face.
We had to wait in a __________ queue to buy the tickets.

vocabularies.definition: A deep, dark shade of the color brown.
vocabularies.example:
She has dark brown eyes and black hair.
He wears a dark brown coat.
The cabinet is made of dark brown wood.
quizzes: Her hair is almost black, but in the sun you can see it is __________.
He has chocolate-colored, __________ eyes.
The soil in the garden is a rich, __________ color.

vocabularies.definition: Of a color intermediate between black and white, as of ashes or lead.
vocabularies.example:
He has gray hair at the temples.
My grandmother's hair is completely gray.
His gray beard makes him look very wise.
quizzes: Many people get __________ hair as they grow older.
She has short __________ hair and always wears a smile.
He decided not to dye his __________ hair.

vocabularies.definition: Having curves; not straight (used to describe hair).
vocabularies.example:
She has long wavy blond hair.
His hair is naturally wavy.
I like her wavy hairstyle.
quizzes: Her hair is neither straight nor curly, it is just __________.
She used a curling iron to make her hair look __________.
The boy with the __________ hair is my classmate.

vocabularies.definition: Having or showing grace or elegance in movement or form.
vocabularies.example:
She is a very graceful dancer.
The swan made a graceful movement across the water.
Her handwriting is beautiful and graceful.
quizzes: The ballerina performed a __________ leap on the stage.
She is known for her __________ manners and polite speech.
The cat made a __________ jump onto the high wall.

vocabularies.definition: Feeling or showing confidence in oneself; self-assured.
vocabularies.example:
She is confident that she will pass the exam.
He gave a very confident speech.
You need to look confident during the interview.
quizzes: He is a __________ boy who is not afraid to speak in public.
The more you practice, the more __________ you will feel.
She walked onto the stage with a __________ smile.

vocabularies.definition: Not excited, nervous, or upset; peaceful.
vocabularies.example:
Try to stay calm and don't panic.
He has a very calm voice.
The sea is calm and peaceful today.
quizzes: The teacher spoke in a __________ voice to quiet the students.
She remained __________ even during the emergency.
Yoga helps me keep my mind __________ and relaxed.

vocabularies.definition: Awkward in movement or in handling things.
vocabularies.example:
I am very clumsy and always drop things.
That was a clumsy mistake.
He is a clumsy boy but very kind.
quizzes: The __________ waiter spilled soup on the customer's lap.
I'm so __________; I keep bumping into the furniture.
She made a __________ attempt to catch the falling glass.

vocabularies.definition: Anxious or troubled about actual or potential problems.
vocabularies.example:
She looks worried about her grades.
My parents were worried when I came home late.
Don't look so worried, everything will be fine.
quizzes: The doctor had a __________ expression on his face.
She was __________ that she might miss her flight.
He is __________ about his upcoming math test.

vocabularies.definition: Fearful; frightened.
vocabularies.example:
She is scared of spiders.
He was too scared to speak.
Don't be scared, the dog is friendly.
quizzes: The little boy was __________ of the loud thunder.
She felt __________ when she walked home alone in the dark.
Are you __________ of watching horror movies?

vocabularies.definition: Giving or ready to give help.
vocabularies.example:
The staff were very polite and helpful.
He gave me some helpful advice.
She is a helpful girl who loves to clean the classroom.
quizzes: Thank you for being so __________ during my moving day.
The library guide was very __________ in finding the right book.
It is __________ to write down new vocabulary in a notebook.

vocabularies.definition: Having or showing an intense and selfish desire for wealth, power, or food.
vocabularies.example:
Don't be greedy, share the cake with your friends.
He is a greedy businessman who only cares about money.
The greedy dog wanted all the bones.
quizzes: The __________ boy ate all the candies and left none for others.
It is __________ to take more food than you can eat.
The story teaches us that __________ people often end up with nothing.

vocabularies.definition: Feeling or showing the need for food.
vocabularies.example:
I am so hungry, I could eat a horse.
The hungry children devoured the pizza.
If you are hungry, there is some fruit in the kitchen.
quizzes: The baby started crying because she was __________.
I skipped breakfast today, so I am very __________ now.
They fed the __________ stray dog some food.

vocabularies.definition: Having or showing a friendly, generous, and considerate nature.
vocabularies.example:
She is a very kind person.
Thank you for your kind words.
He was kind enough to help me carry my bags.
quizzes: Be __________ to animals and do not hurt them.
The __________ teacher explained the lesson again for us.
It was very __________ of you to share your lunch.

vocabularies.definition: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.
vocabularies.example:
He is a very polite young man.
It is polite to say 'please' and 'thank you'.
She gave a polite answer to the question.
quizzes: A __________ child always greets the elders.
It is not __________ to interrupt people when they are talking.
He was very __________ and held the door open for me.

vocabularies.definition: Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.
vocabularies.example:
I am so happy to see you!
They lived a happy life together.
She has a happy smile on her face.
quizzes: We wish you a __________ birthday and a great year ahead.
The children looked very __________ playing in the park.
Winning the game made the whole team extremely __________.

vocabularies.definition: Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.
vocabularies.example:
She felt sad when her friend moved away.
It is a sad story with a tragic ending.
Why do you look so sad today?
quizzes: The little girl was __________ because she lost her toy.
It is __________ to see the old trees being cut down.
He felt __________ after saying goodbye to his family.

vocabularies.definition: Badly behaved or disobedient (especially of a child).
vocabularies.example:
He was a naughty boy who liked to play tricks on his friends.
Don't be naughty, listen to your teacher.
The naughty puppy chewed on my shoes.
quizzes: The __________ child drew crayons all over the clean wall.
He was punished for his __________ behavior at school.
The teacher told the __________ students to sit quietly.

vocabularies.meaning: yên tĩnh, im lặng, trầm tính
vocabularies.definition: Making little or no noise; silent or peaceful.
vocabularies.example:
Please be quiet in the library.
He is a very quiet and shy boy.
It was a quiet night in the countryside.
quizzes: The classroom became __________ when the teacher entered.
She prefers a __________ place to read her books.
He is a __________ student who rarely speaks in class.

vocabularies.definition: Feeling or showing surprise because something unexpected has happened.
vocabularies.example:
She was surprised by the sudden party.
He looked surprised to see me there.
I was surprised that he passed the test.
quizzes: She was pleasantly __________ by the lovely gift.
He had a __________ look on his face when he heard the news.
We were __________ to find the shop closed so early.

vocabularies.definition: In a state of sleep.
vocabularies.example:
The baby fell asleep in her mother's arms.
He is still fast asleep in bed.
Don't make any noise, she is asleep.
quizzes: The cat was sound __________ on the warm rug.
He fell __________ while watching the boring movie.
I checked on the kids and found them both fast __________.

vocabularies.definition: Bad-tempered and irritable.
vocabularies.example:
He is always grumpy in the morning.
Why are you so grumpy today?
The grumpy old man complained about the noise.
quizzes: She gets __________ when she does not get enough sleep.
He gave a __________ reply and walked away.
Don't be so __________; smile and have some fun!

vocabularies.definition: Not asleep.
vocabularies.example:
I was awake all night worrying about the exam.
Is the baby awake yet?
He tried hard to stay awake during the lecture.
quizzes: I was still wide __________ when the sun started to rise.
She lay __________ in bed, listening to the rain.
Please wake him up if he is not __________ yet.

vocabularies.definition: Unable to think clearly; bewildered.
vocabularies.example:
I am confused about the new rules.
He looked confused when I asked the question.
Her instructions only made us more confused.
quizzes: The students looked __________ by the difficult math problem.
If you are __________, please ask the teacher for help.
I got __________ and took the wrong turn on the road.

vocabularies.definition: Making a lot of noise.
vocabularies.example:
The classroom was very noisy.
He bought a noisy toy for his nephew.
I can't sleep because of the noisy street.
quizzes: The children were very __________ during the playground games.
They live in a __________ neighborhood near the airport.
The old washing machine is very __________ when it runs.

vocabularies.definition: Unwilling to work or use energy.
vocabularies.example:
He is too lazy to do his homework.
We had a lazy Sunday at home.
Don't be lazy, get up and exercise!
quizzes: A __________ person rarely helps with the housework.
She spent a __________ afternoon lying on the couch.
The dog is very __________ and sleeps all day long.

vocabularies.definition: Having great physical power or ability to resist force.
vocabularies.example:
He is a strong man who can lift heavy weights.
She has a strong mind and never gives up.
The wind was so strong that it blew away my hat.
quizzes: You need to eat healthy food to grow up __________ and healthy.
The bridge is made of steel and is very __________.
He is a __________ swimmer who has won many medals.

vocabularies.definition: Causing laughter or amusement; humorous.
vocabularies.example:
He told a funny joke that made everyone laugh.
She is a very funny girl.
It is a funny movie that you should watch.
quizzes: The clown did some __________ tricks at the birthday party.
He is the __________est student in our class and makes us laugh.
She wrote a __________ story about a cat that could talk.

vocabularies.definition: Having or showing a quick-witted intelligence.
vocabularies.example:
She is a very smart student who always gets straight A's.
He made a smart decision to save his money.
That is a smart device that can be controlled by your phone.
quizzes: The __________ dog learned the trick in just five minutes.
He is a __________ boy who loves reading science books.
She came up with a __________ solution to the puzzle.

grammars.description: Sử dụng tính từ để miêu tả ngoại hình, tính cách và cảm xúc của một người.
grammars.example:
She has long curly brown hair.
He is a very smart and helpful boy.
My grandfather is old, but he is still strong.
